name: Scotty Cameron 2026 Phantom 5
community_verdict: The compact wingback mallet favoured by tour pros worldwide. New Studio Carbon Steel face insert with chain-link milling delivers softer feel and sharper distance control than any previous Phantom. Multiple shaft and neck configurations fit straight through slight arc strokes. Used by Viktor Hovland and Tommy Fleetwood.

name: Scotty Cameron 2026 Phantom 7
community_verdict: Larger wingback mallet with more aggressive alignment for golfers who want maximum confidence over the ball. Face-balanced double-bend shaft fits straight putting strokes. Heavy visual alignment cues are a love-or-hate proposition — those who like them are very loyal. High MOI makes it the most forgiving Phantom shape.

name: Scotty Cameron 2026 Phantom 9R
community_verdict: Brand new for 2026 — the most rounded shape in the Phantom family with a shorter abbreviated sightline. Designed for golfers who want mallet stability without the angular look of the 5 or 7. Two sightline options (9R single line and 9.2R abbreviated) cater to different alignment preferences.

name: Scotty Cameron Studio Style Newport 2
community_verdict: The putter that started it all. Newport 2 is the most played putter shape in the history of professional golf and the 2025 Studio Style redesign brings it into the modern era with Studio Carbon Steel inserts and chain-link milling. If you have a slight-to-strong arc and want the ultimate blade feel, there is nothing better.

name: Scotty Cameron Studio Style Fastback 1.5
community_verdict: Scotty's 'inbetweener' — sits perfectly between the classic Newport and larger shapes like the Squareback. New 2025 redesign with SCS insert and chain-link milling gives it modern feel while keeping the clean minimal look. Cameron calls the Newport 2.5 Plus range the ideal bridge for golfers not yet ready for a full mallet.

name: Odyssey Ai-DUAL Jailbird Mini
community_verdict: One of the most popular shapes on tour and now with the new Ai-DUAL insert — two layers of urethane for softer feel with the inner firmer layer providing consistent speed across the face. New half-ball alignment system holed 11.3% more putts on 6-foot putts in testing. At $299 it's exceptional value compared to Scotty Cameron.

name: Odyssey Ai-DUAL Double Wide
community_verdict: Maximum forgiveness and alignment in one package. Wide body design with new Ai-DUAL insert and half-ball alignment system. Best for straight stroke putters who want every possible advantage with alignment and consistency. Outstanding value at $299 — delivers performance closer to the $499 Scotty Cameron mallets.

name: Odyssey Ai-One Milled Two T
community_verdict: Premium milled titanium insert with AI-designed contours — putts finish 10% closer to the hole than a typical milled face. Sweet spot is significantly larger than it looks. Jon Rahm used the Rossie version to win the 2023 Masters and kept it ever since. Outstanding feel and distance control for players who prefer a blade.

name: Odyssey Ai-DUAL S2S Jailbird
community_verdict: Zero-torque design stays square to the path rather than naturally opening and closing. Best for straight stroke putters who struggle with face rotation. New Ai-DUAL insert and two-degree forward press with reverse-taper grip. Insert putters now account for 65% of worldwide putter sales — this is the premium zero-torque option at an accessible price.

name: TaylorMade Spider Tour X
community_verdict: Rory McIlroy used this to complete the career Grand Slam in 2025 and win The Masters, The Players, and AT&T Pebble Beach. Best overall mallet putter in multiple 2025 and 2026 tests. 40% of the world's top 20 use a Spider model. Thin wall undercut construction and steel wireframe deliver iconic Spider stability. The benchmark high-MOI mallet.

name: TaylorMade Spider 5K ZT
community_verdict: Second overall in MyGolfSpy's 2025 Most Wanted Zero-Torque test with the best long-range PuttView Handicap of any zero-torque putter tested. Toe-up control design promotes ultra-stable balanced strokes. Best for straight stroke putters who struggle with face rotation on longer putts. The Spider franchise in zero-torque form.

name: TaylorMade SYSTM2
community_verdict: TaylorMade's entry-level premium putter using MIM construction — the same precision manufacturing process used in their King wedges. Flymill face for consistent speed. Under $300 making it the most accessible TaylorMade mallet. Good for golfers who want Spider-inspired performance without the premium price tag.

name: Ping PLD Milled Anser
community_verdict: The putter that invented the modern putter. Now precision milled from 303 stainless steel requiring over 4 hours on the mill per head. Tour validated by Viktor Hovland, Tony Finau, and Bubba Watson. Best suited for slight arc strokes. Shallow face milling gives a firmer feel than insert putters — perfect for feel-obsessed golfers.

name: Ping PLD Milled DS72
community_verdict: Viktor Hovland's preferred model — face-balanced mallet with outstanding forgiveness and premium milled feel. The DS72 shape bridges the gap between blade and full mallet, offering stability without the bulk. One of the best feeling mid-mallets in golf. Multiple tour wins confirm its performance.

name: Ping Scottsdale Anser
community_verdict: More forgiving than the PLD version thanks to Pebax polymer insert and slightly oversized head — 11% higher MOI. At $270 it's a fantastic entry into the Anser family for golfers who want the classic shape with more forgiveness. Soft insert feel is more approachable than the firmer PLD. Outstanding value.

name: Ping Scottsdale Ketsch G
community_verdict: Best MOI performance in the Ping Scottsdale lineup. Stretched wide-body competes with the most forgiving putters on the market at any price. Pebax polymer insert for soft feel. Outstanding value at $270 for golfers who want maximum forgiveness and strong alignment aids. Ping's most forgiving putter shape.

name: Cleveland Frontline Elite 1.0
community_verdict: Cleveland's most affordable premium putter with tungsten SOFT face for consistent ball speed across the entire face. Forward CG from tungsten material promotes straighter putts. 2135 Sightline technology positions the alignment aid at the equator of the golf ball for better visual alignment. Best value blade putter on the market at $199.

name: Cleveland Frontline Elite Elevado
community_verdict: Cleveland's forgiving mallet at the best price point in the category. Tungsten SOFT face, adjustable sole and counterbalance weights for ideal feel in any length. 2135 Sightline technology for alignment. For golfers who want Spider-style mallet performance without the $349 price tag, the Elevado at $199 is a compelling alternative.
